description: This brand was created to provide political and religious commentary from a paleo-conservative's perspective, especially on the 2nd Amendment. By 17 years old, on-top of my other projects, I was writing blog posts, submitting editorials, producing videos, managing multiple social media accounts, and designing merch for the MilitiaOfOne Blog. After being banned from most Social Media during the 2020 Election, the blog has rebranded and is available on Substack.
title: MilitiaOfOne | Alec Pavlik
